scope: F04 A committed connectivity event to B DeviceEventCreate; synthetic vectors, not live evidence

mapping.source_event_id: same original UUID rendered as text, never regenerated on retry
mapping.device_id: trusted registered UUID rendered as text
mapping.warehouse_id: original event binding; held_unbound events are not sent
mapping.related_source_event_id: new recovery source references original offline source
mapping.reason: retained in A event/history through source/device identity; B current DTO has no reason field

failures.held_unbound: no B call and no historical rebinding
failures.temporary_storage_failure: keep pending, retry same source/body with caller-controlled backoff
failures.b_committed_a_checkpoint_failed: keep pending; replay B duplicate then mark A
failures.invalid_or_conflict: blocked, do not mark delivered or busy-loop
